build_pipeline: build a multithreaded SPDL pipeline with GPU NVDEC video decoding for video classification
create_demux: create a Demux callable that demuxes video bytes into packets and resolves labels to class indices
create_nvdec_decode: create an NvdecDecode callable that decodes video packets using GPU NVDEC hardware decoder with frame sampling
collate_batch: collate a list of video and label tensors into a batched dictionary with stacked tensors
review_build_pipeline: review the build_pipeline function that assembles a split demux/decode SPDL pipeline with distributed sampling
